annotations.title: Chercher une race / Look up breeds

description: Look up dog and cat breeds in Mission Museaux's directory by full or partial name, or list the most common. Use it to check a breed name. Returns French and English names, other names, FCI standard, origin, listings and adoptions per breed, and its page. Dogs and cats only. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

espece.description: Species: chat (cat) or chien (dog); the directory only covers cats and dogs. cat or dog are accepted. Omit for both.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

limite.description: Number of breeds to return (whole number, 1 to 30, default 10); a larger value is lowered to 30.

recherche.description: Breed name in French or English, full or partial (string, 2 to 60 characters), e.g. "berger", "retriever" or "Maine coon". Omit it to list the most common breeds.
